body.prompt: Use the supplied full-screen Failure image only as a visual style/design reference. Create one new independent game resource, never a screenshot crop or screen reconstruction. Create ONLY the large tall outer navy panel from the lower half of the reference, as a complete blank UI surface. Nearly square portrait proportions width:height 0.88:1. A restrained thin double antique-gold border, elegant generous curling scroll corner filigree, small sapphire crest centered at bottom edge, a large near-black navy finely textured empty interior. Match the reference outer frame contour, corner curls and dark materials closely. No internal sections, dividers, inset panels, title plaque, controls or content; this is just the outer blank backing. Modest margin outside full carvings. True transparent alpha outside the complete object; preserve fully opaque interior surfaces. No checkerboard, no background scenery, no letters, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no extra items. Leave a small clear margin so all ornament tips are visible.
